mapper.select: select account_id, emp_id, login_id, password, enabled, fail_count, is_locked, locked_at, created_at, last_login_at from account where login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.update: update account set fail_count = 0, last_login_at = now() where account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.select: select account_id, login_id, enabled, fail_count, is_locked, locked_at, created_at, last_login_at from account where emp_id = #{empId}
mapper.insert: insert into account(emp_id, login_id, password, enabled) values(#{emp.empId}, #{loginId}, #{password}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT account_id, login_id FROM account WHERE account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT a.account_id, a.login_id, a.enabled, a.fail_count, a.is_locked, a.last_login_at, e.emp_id, e.emp_no, e.ename FROM account a JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = a.emp_id WHERE a.enabled = 1 AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY a.account_id

SELECT account_id, login_id, enabled
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} AND a.enabled = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp e WHERE e.emp_id = a.emp_id AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.sql: select a.account_id, a.login_id, a.enabled, a.fail_count, a.is_locked, a.locked_at, a.last_login_at, e.emp_id, e.emp_no, e.ename, e.status as emp_status, d.department_name, j.job_name, (select group_concat(r.role_name order by r.hr_role_id separator ', ') from account_role ar join hr_role r on r.hr_role_id = ar.hr_role_id where ar.account_id = a.account_id and r.is_active = 1) as role_names from account a join emp e on e.emp_id = a.emp_id left join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id left join job j on j.job_id = e.job_id

where.if: and (a.login_id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or e.ename like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or e.emp_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: order by (a.enabled = 1 and a.is_locked = 1) desc, e.emp_no limit #{offset}, #{size}
select count(*) from account a join emp e on e.emp_id = a.emp_id

select case when enabled = 0 then 'DISABLED' when is_locked = 1 then 'LOCKED' else 'ACTIVE' end as status, count(*) as cnt from account group by case when enabled = 0 then 'DISABLED' when is_locked = 1 then 'LOCKED' else 'ACTIVE' end
